note: Frozen copy of the H5N1 risk dashboard data. Sources were captured by the Wayback Machine from this site's own API routes between 2025-01-08 and 2025-02-08; the underlying markets have since closed and their APIs no longer serve history.
formula: index = (metaculus*0.5 + kalshiTravel*0.1 + kalshiCases*0.5) / 3, hourly, linear interpolation between source points

metaculus.question: Will CDC report 10,000 or more H5 avian influenza cases in the United States before January 1, 2026?

kalshiCases.market: KXH5N1CASES-25-10000: Above 10,000 US bird flu (H5N1) cases in 2025?

kalshiTravel.market: KXCDCTRAVELH5-26-3: Will the CDC recommend delaying non-essential travel due to H5 bird flu before 2026?

polymarket.market: Another state declare a state of emergency over bird flu before February (2025)?
